defs.def: a simple drawing using lines to explain where sth is, how sth works, etc. 简图；图解；图表；示意图adj.adv.

ex.s: Ecosystems [5 Look at the diagram and answer the questions.
ex.t: 生态系统 [5 看图回答问题。

ex.s: Sometimes it is a good idea to draw a diagram to organise the information in the passage.
ex.t: 有时画一个图表来整理文章中的信息是个好主意。

ex.s: Draw a diagram Diagrams are very useful tools that can be used to brainstorm ideas, map out processes, show cause and effect relationships, explain a new idea or concept, and so on.
ex.t: 画图表：图表是非常有用的工具，可以用来头脑风暴想法、梳理流程、展示因果关系、解释一个新的想法或概念等等。

ex.s: When you read an essay about scientific issues, you can try drawing a diagram, which will not only allow you to visualise the problems more clearly but also can help demonstrate your creative thinking and problem-solving.
ex.t: 当你阅读关于科学问题的文章时，可以尝试画一个图表，这不仅让你更清晰地可视化问题，还能帮助展示你的创造性思维和解决问题的能力。

ex.s: Use diagrams and illustrations to show how your ideas will work.
ex.t: 使用图表和插图来展示你的想法如何运作。
